options.name: channel
options.description: A Xfconf preference channel is a top-level tree key, inside of the Xfconf repository that corresponds to the location for which all application properties/keys are stored. If not provided, the module lists all available channels.

options.name: property
options.description: A Xfce preference key is an element in the Xfconf repository that corresponds to an application preference. If provided, then O(channel) is required. If not provided and a O(channel) is provided, then the module lists all available properties in that O(channel).
